title: Identication and Estimation of Nonsymmetric Determinantal Point Processes
abstract: arXiv:2610.14520v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Determinantal point processes (DPPs) provide tractable distributions for nite random sets, but the usual symmetric-kernel specication imposes nonpositive pairwise dependence. Statistical research on nonsymmetric DPPs, which can accommodate positive dependence, remains limited. We study identication and estimation for this class. First, we establish the equivalence of two sucient conditions for a nonsymmetric kernel to dene a valid DPP. Second, we develop the identication theory for nonsymmetric DPPs. Third, we develop cardinality-truncated maximum-likelihood estimation and estimation by averaged stochastic gradient descent. Under suitable identication and regularity conditions, we establish consistency and asymptotic normality for both estimators. Simulations examine identication, the eects of truncation, and the nite-sample performance of the estimators. We illustrate the methods with two cyber applications at markedly dierent sampling

translated_title: 非对称行列式点过程的识别与估计
translated_abstract: 行列式点过程为有限随机集合提供了易于处理的分布，但通常采用的对称核设定强制要求成对依赖为非正。能够容纳正依赖的非对称行列式点过程的统计研究仍然有限。本文研究这一类过程的识别与估计问题。首先，我们建立了非对称核定义有效行列式点过程的两个充分条件之间的等价性。其次，我们发展了非对称行列式点过程的识别理论。第三，我们提出了基数截断极大似然估计方法以及基于平均随机梯度下降的估计方法。在适当的识别和正则性条件下，我们证明了两种估计量的一致性和渐近正态性。模拟实验考察了识别问题、截断的影响以及估计量的有限样本表现。我们通过两个采样规模截然不同的网络应用来演示这些方法。
tldr: 本文针对能够容纳正依赖的非对称行列式点过程，建立了核有效性条件的等价性与识别理论，并提出了基数截断极大似然估计和平均随机梯度下降估计两种方法，证明了一致性与渐近正态性。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes the equivalence of kernel validity conditions and an identification theory for nonsymmetric determinantal point processes that can accommodate positive dependence, and develops cardinality-truncated maximum-likelihood and averaged stochastic gradient descent estimators with proven consistency and asymptotic normality.
